description.zh: 业务键，如场站名称编号。
description.en: The business key, such as a station name or ID.

description.zh:
本次调用的数据模式，枚举值：
- FULL：全量数据（仅使用本次调用中传递的数据）
- INCREMENTAL：增量数据（自动关联使用历史调用中相同BusinessKey的数据）
description.en:
The data mode for this call. Valid values:
- FULL: full data (uses only the data passed in this call)
- INCREMENTAL: incremental data (automatically associates data from previous calls with the same BusinessKey).

description.zh:
设备类型，每个系统类型支持的设备类型有：
-  solar:  solarInverter --光伏逆变器
- wind: windTurbine--风电发电机
description.en:
The device type. The device types supported by each system type are as follows:
-  solar: solarInverter (solar inverter)
- wind: windTurbine (wind turbine).

description.zh:
从运行日(含)开始, 预测时长（单位：天）。

非必填，默认1天。
description.en:
The forecast duration in days, starting from the run date (inclusive).

Optional. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
预测时间尺度，枚举值：
- DAY_AHEAD：日前预测
- INTRADAY：日内预测
description.en:
The forecast time horizon. Valid values:
- DAY_AHEAD: day-ahead forecast
- INTRADAY: intraday forecast.

description.zh:
默认值为FIFTEEN_MIN；需要与历史数据的数据频率一致；枚举值：
- FIFTEEN_MIN: 15分钟
- FIVE_MIN: 5分钟
- ONE_HOUR: 1小时
- ONE_DAY: 1天
description.en:
Default value: FIFTEEN_MIN. The value must match the data frequency of the historical data. Valid values:
- FIFTEEN_MIN: 15 minutes
- FIVE_MIN: 5 minutes
- ONE_HOUR: 1 hour
- ONE_DAY: 1 day.

description.zh: 历史数据csv文件url地址，在调用期间地址需要公网可访问。
description.en: The URL of the historical data CSV file. The URL must be publicly accessible during the call.
The location information, including longitude and latitude.

description.zh: 模型对应的版本号，默认为latest；可根据文档查询版本号，以调用历史快照版本，或preview版本。
description.en: The version number of the model. Default value: latest. You can query the version number in the documentation to call a historical snapshot version or a preview version.
The run date, accurate to the day, in the "yyyy-MM-dd" format.

description.zh:
系统类型，支持的系统类型有： 
- solar: 光伏
- wind: 风电
description.en:
The system type. Valid values: 
- solar: photovoltaic
- wind: wind power.

description.zh: 历史数据csv文件中的时间列，时间列需要符合 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:SS格式，数据频率需要与freq字段对齐。
description.en: The time column in the historical data CSV file. The time column must be in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:SS format. The data frequency must match the Freq parameter.
The time zone. Default value: Asia/Shanghai.

description.zh: 历史数据csv文件中的值列，需要为数值类型。
description.en: The value column in the historical data CSV file. The value must be a numeric type.

title.zh: 通过文件URL创建功率预测任务
title.en: Create a power forecast task by file URL
